title: Starter
source_docs: Powertrain Blockset/Energy Storage and Auxiliary Drive/Starter/Starter.md
text: Starter as a DC motor, 3 outputs, {Motor Type} sets Select motor type Separately Excited DC; {Armature winding resistance, Ra} sets the resistance, {Armature winding inductance, La} sets the inductance .1, {Field winding resistance, Rf} sets the resistance .3, {Field winding inductance, Lf} sets the inductance .2, {Mutual inductance, Laf} sets the inductance .3, {Initial armature current and field current, Iaf} sets the current, {Armature winding resistance, Rapm} sets the resistance .5, {Armature winding inductance, Lapm} sets the inductance .1, {Torque constant, Kt} sets the motor torque constant .1, {Initial armature current, Ia} sets the current .1, {Total resistance, Rser} sets the resistance .1, {Total inductance, Lser} sets the inductance .1, {Initial current, Iafser} sets the current and {Mutual inductance, Lafser} sets the inductance .3. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Motor Type
params.values: Select motor type Separately Excited DC Motor (default) | Permanent Magnet Excited DC Motor | Series Connection DC Motor

params.name: Initial armature current and field current, Iaf
